## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets`, and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] `cargo deny check` passes (if dependencies changed)

      (`./e2e/sdk_compat/run.sh`)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
